title: Delivery follow-up
syncDone: {{checked}} parcels checked with the couriers · {{changed}} status(es) updated

kpiSub.traites: back on the road after the alert

help.alertes: Parcels flagged by the courier or the livreur (customer absent, refused, address…). Handle them: call the customer, then « Handle » or « Customer cancels ».
help.traites: Alerts already handled: the parcel is back on the road. It leaves this list once delivered or cancelled.
help.livres: Parcels delivered in the last 30 days.
help.annules: Parcels cancelled by the customer, still with the courier or the livreur, on their way back to the depot. To give one directly to another customer: Suivi → Swap.
help.swap: Give a cancelled parcel directly to another customer instead of bringing it back to the depot. Below: parcels already swapped, with « Copy for ZR ».

empty.livres: No parcel delivered in the last 30 days.
empty.annules: No cancelled parcel on its way back.
empty.swap: No cancelled parcel with a courier or a livreur right now.

treat.title: Handle the alert · {{ref}}
treat.notePh: e.g. customer at work, deliver after 5 pm

cancelText: The parcel goes to « Returning ». In Cancelled you can swap it to another customer.

swapM.title: Swap parcel {{ref}}
swapM.cands: Confirmed orders with the same product
swapM.candsHelp: A confirmed order is being prepared at the depot: the one you choose leaves preparation and goes with this parcel. Same wilaya first, then those still « To prepare » (not packed) before « In dispatch » (already packed), then same variant, then the oldest.
swapM.noCands: No confirmed order (being prepared) with the same product. Search another customer below.
swapM.searchPh: Ref. PX…, phone or customer name
swapM.noFound: No confirmed, not yet shipped order matches. Create the new customer's order first, then come back here.
swapM.mismatch: The parcel contains « {{a}} », order {{ref}} asks for « {{b}} ». Check with the customer before swapping.
swapM.pick: Choose the order that receives the parcel.

sheet.title: Parcel swapped
sheet.ok: {{a}} → Cancelled · swapped · {{b}} → Out for delivery · swapped
sheet.wasPrepared: {{ref}} was « In dispatch », already packed. Do not ship it: open the parcel and put the products back on the shelf (stock did not move, nothing to fix).
sheet.wasToPrepare: {{ref}} leaves « To prepare ». If it is already on the picking sheet, do not prepare it: it goes with the parcel of {{from}}.
sheet.copyEach: For {{who}}: copy each field one by one
sheet.copyHint: copy each line to finish (phone 2, wilaya and commune are optional)
sheet.selected: Text selected: copy it (Ctrl+C or long press)
sheet.companyWarn: {{company}}: in the courier's space, find the parcel by the old tracking number, then change the name, the phone and the amount.
sheet.ownInfo: Your own livreur: nothing to change with a courier. He keeps the same parcel (label {{tracking}}) and delivers it to the new customer.

rec.searchPh: Customer name, phone, ref. PX…, tracking number
rec.searchInfo: Claims desk: type a name, a phone number (even part of it), a PX… reference or a tracking number. All orders are searched, whatever their status or date. Click an order to see its full history.
rec.companiesHelp: ZR, Yalidine, NOEST… have no API for claims: Pilotix prepares the full message (tracking, ref., customer, problem) and sends it by WhatsApp or e-mail to the courier's customer service. Each claim stays here until answered; after 48 h without answer it turns red: remind in one click.
rec.livreursHelp: For parcels of your own livreurs: the message goes to the livreur's WhatsApp. Write down the answer here.
rec.emptyOpen: No claim waiting. To create one: « + New claim ».
rec.answer: Write the answer / change the status
rec.orderPh: Ref. PX…, tracking, phone or name
rec.noOrder: No order sent to a courier or a livreur matches.
rec.detailsPh: What the customer says, what you ask the courier…
rec.sendHelp: Check the message, then choose how to send it to {{name}}. The claim stays « Waiting » until answered.
rec.noContact: No WhatsApp or e-mail saved for {{name}}: WhatsApp will let you pick the contact, or copy the message.
rec.answerPh: What the courier answered, or what was done

reasons.relivrer: Customer reached: please deliver the parcel again
reasons.fakedeliv: Marked delivered, but the customer received nothing
reasons.fakeret: Wrong return or cancellation (customer wants the parcel)
reasons.address: Change the customer's address or phone
reasons.noreturn: Return not yet brought back to the depot

text.title: Claim {{ref}} — {{shop}}
text.thanks: Thank you for your quick answer.
text.thanksAgain: We have no answer yet. Please handle this claim as a priority.
